search.query: | mstats avg("backup.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value

| mstats avg("backup.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name IN ("*last_snapshot_age_hours*","*last_update_age_hours*") | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value

| mstats avg("backup.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name IN ("*snapshots*","*timers*","*configured*") | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value
